newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Solid Group falls 17.89 pct on jv news.
newsitem.headline: Solid Group falls 17.89 pct on jv news.

text.p: Philippine electronics distributor Solid Group Inc dropped by 85 centavos or 17.89 percent to 3.90 pesos in late Manila trade on Monday on worries over its joint venture with Sony Corp, traders said.
"Investors were worried that the venture would pare Solid's earnings from distributing Sony products," said one trader.

Solid announced last week that it had signed an eight-year agreement with Sony for a local electronics joint venture under which the new firm will sell and market Sony's audio, video and other products.
Traders said they expected Solid's earnings to fall as it has to share distribution earnings with the new venture, Sony Philippines Inc.
Some 3.6 million shares of Solid Group were traded as of 11:33 a.m. (0333 GMT).
